fields.zone: The physical area or department of the facility.
fields.role: The job title or classification of the person.
fields.authorization: Whether access or action is permitted.
fields.station: The specific equipment or workstation identifier.
fields.rule: The narrative statement of a governing rule or operational constraint.
fields.subject: The entity or station that the rule or observation applies to.
fields.sensor: The type of measurement being tracked.
fields.unit: The unit of measure for the sensor value.
fields.nominal: The target or ideal operating value.
fields.critical_response: The required action when a critical threshold is breached.
fields.action: The required task or corrective measure to be performed.
fields.station_id: The unique identifier for a station.
fields.depends_on: The station or system that the current record relies upon.
fields.downstream_effect: The impact of a fault or state on subsequent stations.
fields.trigger: The specific condition or event that initiates a response.
fields.priority: The importance or urgency level of the record.
fields.max_persons: The maximum number of people allowed in a zone.
fields.enforcement: The policy for how limits are enforced or monitored.
fields.anomaly_type: The classification of the detected deviation.
fields.definition: The technical description of what constitutes an anomaly.
fields.detection_criterion: The mathematical or logical rule used to detect an anomaly.
fields.ontology_class: The formal system classification of the event.
fields.max_ack_warning_min: The maximum allowed time to acknowledge a warning.
fields.max_ack_critical_min: The maximum allowed time to acknowledge a critical alarm.
fields.requirement: A mandatory operational or logging obligation.
fields.pattern: The causal chain or sequence of events.
fields.primary_fault: The root cause of the failure.
fields.secondary_effect: The resulting symptoms or side effects of a primary fault.
fields.resolution: The step-by-step procedure to fix the issue.
fields.condition: The prose stating when a rule applies.
fields.station_dependencies: The overall flow or sequence of stations.
fields.primary_criterion: The main goal or standard being measured.
fields.threshold_hierarchy: The logical ordering of threshold levels.

categories.AccessAuthorization: Rules regarding who is permitted to enter or act.
categories.SensorThreshold: Limits and ranges for sensor measurements.
categories.OccupancyLimit: Maximum allowed persons in a space.
categories.AcknowledgmentTime: Time limits for responding to alarms.
categories.FaultResolutionProcedure: Steps to resolve a detected fault.
categories.EnvironmentalMonitoringResponse: Actions taken based on environmental data.
categories.FaultPropagationRule: How faults move through the system.
categories.VerificationProcedure: Steps to verify a state or fix.
categories.EscalationProcedure: Steps for increasing the urgency of a response.
